info.title: SYNTHORA Onchain Primitives (multichain)
info.description: Multichain deterministic onchain primitives: transaction receipts, tx lookup, wallet nonce, contract & EIP-1967 proxy detection, ENS resolution, ERC20 and native balances, contract introspection across Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum and Optimism. Ed25519-signed. Pay-per-use via x402 USDC on Base.
info.x-guidance: POST /service with {"op":"receipt","hash":"0x..","chain":"base"}. ops: receipt, tx, nonce, code, proxy, balance, erc20-balance, contract, network, ens. chains: base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism. Empty body -> ops list.
x-use-cases: resolve an ENS name to an address
reverse-resolve an address to its ENS name
get a transaction receipt and status on Base or Ethereum
detect if a contract is an EIP-1967 proxy and read its implementation
get the next nonce for a wallet before sending a transaction
check if an address is a smart contract
get the ERC20 token balance of a wallet
get the native ETH balance of a wallet on any chain
read a token's name, symbol and decimals
get chain id, latest block and gas price
give an autonomous agent cheap multichain onchain reads
